able.en: having the power to do something
able.ex: She was able to finish the work early.

accelerate.ex: The city wants to accelerate house building.

example.en: The city wants to accelerate the building of schools.
example.zh: 市政府希望加快學校興建。

note.usage: 常見 accelerate the delivery/growth/process；比 speed up 正式。

noteEs.exampleTr: La ciudad quiere acelerar la construcción de escuelas.
noteEs.meaning: hacer que algo ocurra más rápido; acelerar.
noteEs.usage: Se usa accelerate growth/the process; más formal que speed up.

noteHi.exampleTr: शहर स्कूलों का निर्माण तेज़ करना चाहता है।
noteHi.usage: accelerate growth/the process आम है; speed up से औपचारिक।

noteJa.exampleTr: 市は学校の建設を加速させたい。
noteJa.meaning: 進行を速める；加速させる。
noteJa.usage: accelerate growth/the process。speed up より改まった語。

noteKo.exampleTr: 시는 학교 건설을 가속하고 싶어 한다.
noteKo.usage: accelerate growth/the process. speed up보다 격식 있음.

act.en: a law passed by a parliament
act.ex: The new act protects workers' rights.
act.zh: 法案；法令（European Media Freedom Act：歐洲媒體自由法）

addition.en: in addition to: as well as

again.ex: The shop is open again after repairs.

ahead.ex: Hard weeks lie ahead for the farmers.

alike.en: in 'A and B alike': both A and B
alike.ex: Teachers and students alike liked the plan.
alike.zh: 同樣地（A and B alike：A和B都）

allow.ex: The rules allow small shops to open on Sundays.

allowed.ex: Dogs are not allowed in the park.

allowing.ex: The new bridge is allowing faster trips to work.

almost.ex: The bus was almost empty this morning.

also.ex: She speaks French and also some Spanish.

alter.ex: Small mistakes can alter the final result.

altered.ex: The dress was altered to fit her.

amended.ex: The form can be amended before Friday.

anticipated.ex: The anticipated cost of the bridge has doubled.

appeal.en: asking a higher court to change a decision
appeal.ex: She won her appeal in the High Court.
appeal.zh: 上訴（Court of Appeal：上訴法院）

applicants.en: people who ask for a place or job

application.en: a formal written request for permission
application.ex: Her application for a visa was approved.

applications.ex: The council received many planning applications.

approve.ex: Parliament must approve the new law.

are.en: to exist; to have a quality
are.ex: There are three parks near my home.

around.ex: Around forty people joined the walk.

ask.ex: You can ask the teacher for help.

assessment.ex: The safety assessment took six months.

at.en: in a place, time or level

be.en: to exist; to have a quality
be.ex: The new road will be ready next year.

binding.en: that must be obeyed by law
binding.ex: The agreement is binding on both sides.
binding.zh: 有約束力的（legally binding：具法律效力）

blamed.ex: Drivers blamed the snow for the delays.

body.ex: A new body will check food safety.

bring.en: to present; bring a case: start a court case

bring.hi: प्रस्तुत करना; (bring a case) मुक़दमा करना
bring.ja: 提出する；（bring a case）訴訟を起こす
bring.zh: 提出；bring a case：提起訴訟

bringing.ex: The new year is bringing big changes at work.

brought.en: brought forward: put forward for discussion
brought.ex: The plan was brought forward by two ministers.

builders.en: people or companies that build houses
builders.ex: Local builders want more land for homes.

cabinet.en: the group of top government ministers

called.ex: Critics called the decision a mistake.

can.ex: Anyone can join the club for free.

case.ex: The case will go to court next year.

cases.ex: Most court cases take months to finish.

central.ex: Housing is a central issue in the election.

certainty.en: being sure about what will happen
certainty.ex: Investors want certainty before they spend money.

challenge.en: a difficult problem to deal with
challenge.ex: Online fraud is a big challenge for banks.

challengers.en: people who formally question a decision
challengers.ex: The challengers took their case to the High Court.

challenges.ex: The plan survived several court challenges.

change.ex: The change will make the law stricter.

changes.ex: The town has seen big changes in ten years.

clear.ex: Steer clear of the cliffs today.

come.en: come into force: start to apply
come.ex: The new law will come into force in March.

comprehensive.ex: The guide gives a comprehensive list of courses.

example.en: The report gives a comprehensive picture of the problem.
example.zh: 報告全面呈現了這個問題。

note.meaning: 全面的；包含所有方面的。
note.usage: 常見 comprehensive review/plan/set of reforms。

noteEs.exampleTr: El informe ofrece una visión integral del problema.
noteEs.meaning: que incluye todos los aspectos; integral.

noteHi.exampleTr: रिपोर्ट समस्या की व्यापक तस्वीर देती है।
noteHi.meaning: सभी पहलुओं को शामिल करने वाला; व्यापक।

noteJa.exampleTr: 報告書は問題の全体像を包括的に示している。
noteJa.meaning: すべてを含む；包括的な。
noteJa.usage: comprehensive review/plan/set of の形が多い。

consequently.ex: The road was closed; consequently, buses were late.

consistent.ex: Patients need consistent care across all hospitals.

correct.ex: Please correct the date on the form.

corrections.ex: The editor made several corrections to the article.

could.ex: The storm could reach the coast tonight.

court.en: place where legal cases are decided
court.ex: They went to court over the money.

curb.en: to control or limit something bad
curb.ex: The city wants to curb air pollution.

example.en: New rules aim to curb plastic waste.
example.zh: 新規定旨在減少塑膠垃圾。

note.usage: 常見 curb delays/emissions/spending/inflation；也可作名詞 a curb on。

noteEn.meaning: to control or limit something bad.

noteEs.exampleTr: Las nuevas normas buscan frenar los residuos plásticos.
noteEs.usage: Se usa curb emissions/spending; sustantivo a curb on.

noteHi.exampleTr: नए नियमों का उद्देश्य प्लास्टिक कचरा कम करना है।
noteHi.meaning: किसी बुरी चीज़ को रोकना या सीमित करना।
noteHi.usage: curb emissions/spending; संज्ञा a curb on आम हैं।

noteJa.exampleTr: 新しい規則はプラスチックごみの抑制を狙う。
noteJa.meaning: （悪いものを）抑える；抑制する。
noteJa.usage: curb emissions/spending、名詞 a curb on の形が多い。

noteKo.exampleTr: 새 규정은 플라스틱 쓰레기를 줄이는 것이 목표다.
noteKo.usage: curb emissions/spending, 명사 a curb on 형태가 흔하다.

deadlines.en: times by which something must be done
deadlines.ex: The team worked late to meet tight deadlines.

decision-making.ex: Local people want a role in decision-making.

delays.en: times when things happen later than planned
delays.ex: There were long delays at the airport.

delivery.en: the act of providing or building something
delivery.ex: Delays have slowed the delivery of new schools.
delivery.zh: 供應；交付（delivery of housing：住宅供應）

demonstrate.en: to show clearly that something is true
demonstrate.ex: The data demonstrate a clear link.

developers.ex: Developers plan to build flats on the old site.

development.ex: This is an important development in trade.

developments.ex: We will report any new developments.

discuss.ex: The team will discuss the plan on Monday.

do.ex: Do you want to join us?

down.ex: Please slow down near the school.

due.ex: The report is due next week.

duration.ex: You must stay in your seat for the duration of the flight.

effect.en: take effect: start to work or apply
effect.ex: The price rise will take effect on Monday.

eliminated.ex: The disease was eliminated from the country years ago.

enabling.ex: New tools are enabling faster repairs.

enhance.en: to make something better or stronger
enhance.ex: Good lighting can enhance a small room.

enshrined.ex: Free speech is enshrined in the constitution.

example.en: The right to vote is enshrined in the constitution.

note.meaning: （將權利、原則）載入法律或文件；明文規定。
note.usage: 常用被動 be enshrined in law/the constitution。

noteEn.meaning: to write a right or rule into law officially.

noteEs.exampleTr: El derecho al voto está consagrado en la constitución.
noteEs.meaning: consagrar algo en una ley o documento.
noteEs.usage: Se usa en pasiva: be enshrined in law/the constitution.

noteHi.exampleTr: मतदान का अधिकार संविधान में दर्ज है।
noteHi.meaning: किसी अधिकार या सिद्धांत को क़ानून में दर्ज करना।
noteHi.usage: be enshrined in law/the constitution आम है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 投票権は憲法に明記されている。
noteJa.meaning: 権利や原則を法律などに明記する。
noteJa.usage: be enshrined in law/the constitution の受動形が多い。

noteKo.usage: be enshrined in law/the constitution 수동형이 흔하다.

environmental.en: about nature and the natural world
environmental.ex: Plastic is a big environmental problem.

establish.ex: The EU wants to establish new funds.

exempting.en: freeing from a rule or duty
exempting.ex: The law exempts small firms from the new tax.

existing.ex: We will improve the existing system.

expected.ex: The ferry is expected to arrive at noon.

expire.en: to come to an end and stop being valid
expire.ex: My passport will expire next year.

extended.en: made longer, or reached a distance
extended.ex: The line extended to the station.

faster.ex: We need a faster way to pay.

first.ex: The cost was higher than first expected.

fixed.ex: The course runs for a fixed number of weeks.

flexibility.en: the ability to change easily to suit new needs
flexibility.ex: Online booking gives travellers more flexibility.

force.ex: The ban will stay in force until June.
force.zh: come into force：生效（法律效力）

forward.ex: Several ideas were put forward at the meeting.

frequently.ex: The bus is frequently late in winter.

frozen.en: officially stopped from being used or paid
frozen.ex: Their bank accounts were frozen during the investigation.

frustrated.en: annoyed because you cannot do what you want
frustrated.ex: Drivers grew frustrated by the long traffic jam.

full.ex: The river is very full after the rain.

fully.ex: The new hospital is not yet fully open.

further.ex: A further ten jobs will be created.

furthermore.ex: Furthermore, the plan is too costly.

go.en: go ahead: happen; go on to: move to next step
go.es: seguir adelante (go ahead); pasar a (go on to)
go.ex: The concert will go ahead despite the rain.
go.hi: (go ahead) आगे बढ़ना; (go on to) जाना
go.zh: go ahead：進行；go on to：再進一步（上訴）

government.en: the group that runs a country
government.ex: The government plans to build more homes.

greater.ex: Teachers want greater support from parents.

have.ex: We have to leave early tomorrow.
have.ja: 持つ（have to：〜しなければならない）

homes.en: houses or flats to live in

hope.ex: I hope you feel better soon.

impact.ex: The strike had a big impact on schools.

implementation.ex: The implementation of the rule starts in May.

example.en: The implementation of the new law will take two years.

note.usage: 常見 full implementation of、implementation of a policy/plan。

noteEn.meaning: putting a plan or law into action.

noteEs.exampleTr: La aplicación de la nueva ley llevará dos años.
noteEs.usage: Se usa full implementation of, implementation of a plan.

noteHi.exampleTr: नए क़ानून को लागू करने में दो साल लगेंगे।
noteHi.meaning: योजना या क़ानून लागू करना; कार्यान्वयन।
noteHi.usage: full implementation of, implementation of a plan आम हैं।

noteJa.exampleTr: 新しい法律の施行には2年かかる。
noteJa.meaning: 計画や法律の実施；施行。
noteJa.usage: full implementation of、implementation of a plan の形が多い。

noteKo.usage: full implementation of, implementation of a plan 형태가 흔하다.

impose.en: to force something unwelcome on someone

including.en: and also; as part of the total

infrastructure.en: basic systems like roads, power and water

example.zh: 鄉村地區需要更好的基礎設施。

note.meaning: 基礎設施（道路、水電、交通等）。
note.usage: 常見 invest in infrastructure、critical/public infrastructure；不可數。

noteEn.meaning: basic systems like roads, water and power.

noteEs.exampleTr: Las zonas rurales necesitan mejores infraestructuras.
noteEs.meaning: instalaciones básicas como carreteras, agua y energía.
noteEs.usage: Se usa invest in infrastructure; incontable.

noteHi.exampleTr: ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों को बेहतर बुनियादी ढाँचे की ज़रूरत है।
noteHi.meaning: सड़क, पानी, बिजली जैसी बुनियादी सुविधाएँ; अवसंरचना।
noteHi.usage: invest in infrastructure आम है; अगणनीय संज्ञा।

noteJa.exampleTr: 農村部にはより良いインフラが必要だ。
noteJa.meaning: 道路・水道などの基盤施設；インフラ。

noteKo.exampleTr: 농촌 지역에는 더 나은 기반 시설이 필요하다.
noteKo.meaning: 도로, 수도 등 기반 시설; 인프라.

intended.ex: The money is intended for schools.

interest.en: a personal stake in a decision
interest.ex: Only people with an interest in the land can object.
interest.zh: 利害關係（sufficient interest：充分的利害關係）

introduce.en: to start using a new system
introduce.ex: The state will introduce the rule in October.

introduction.ex: The introduction of fees angered students.

is.en: to exist; to have a quality
is.ex: The shop is on the main street.

judicial.ex: The group asked for a judicial review of the plan.

laid.ex: The rules were laid down by the council.

law.ex: The new law will start in January.

leave.en: official permission from a court to start a case

legally.ex: Drivers are legally required to wear seat belts.

lifespan.en: the length of time a person lives
lifespan.ex: Better food has increased the human lifespan.

limits.en: rules about how much is allowed

longer.ex: The trip took longer than we thought.

major.ex: Several major banks raised their rates.

make.ex: Automation can make attacks harder to trace.

making.ex: Making a complaint online is quick and easy.

many.ex: Many people work from home now.

mark.en: to show the start of something
mark.ex: The deal may mark a new start.

marking.ex: The school is marking its 100th year.

mean.ex: Higher costs mean fewer new homes.

measure.en: a measure of: a certain amount of
measure.ex: The new rules give workers a measure of security.

measures.en: actions taken to deal with something

meet.en: to reach a required level or deadline
meet.ex: The builders could not meet the deadline.

meeting.en: an event where people gather to talk

minister.ex: The health minister visited the hospital.

ministers.ex: Ministers will discuss the budget on Tuesday.

minor.ex: There was only minor damage to the car.

modified.en: changed a little to improve it
modified.ex: The company modified its app after complaints.

more.ex: We need more time to finish.

most.ex: This is the most popular park in the city.
most.zh: 最（the most notable：最值得注意的）

national.ex: It is a national holiday today.

near-complete.ex: The building is now near-complete after two years.

nevertheless.ex: It was cold; nevertheless, we went out.

new.ex: The city opened a new library.

not.ex: The plan is not ready yet.

notable.ex: There was a notable rise in sales.

on.ex: Voting will go on for nine days.

option.ex: Cycling is a cheap option for getting to work.

out.en: part of 'run out': end or be used up

overhauled.ex: The tax system will be overhauled next year.

example.en: The government plans to overhaul the tax system.
example.zh: 政府計畫全面改革稅制。

note.meaning: 全面改革；徹底檢修（制度、政策）。
note.usage: 常見 overhaul a system/policy；名詞 a major overhaul of。

noteEn.meaning: to change a system completely to improve it.

noteEs.exampleTr: El gobierno planea reformar a fondo el sistema fiscal.
noteEs.meaning: reformar a fondo un sistema o política.
noteEs.usage: Se usa overhaul a system; sustantivo a major overhaul.

noteHi.exampleTr: सरकार कर प्रणाली में व्यापक सुधार की योजना बना रही है।
noteHi.meaning: किसी व्यवस्था में पूरी तरह बदलाव करना।
noteHi.usage: overhaul a system; संज्ञा a major overhaul आम है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 政府は税制の全面改革を計画している。
noteJa.meaning: 制度などを全面的に見直す・改革する。
noteJa.usage: overhaul a system、名詞 a major overhaul の形が多い。

noteKo.usage: overhaul a system, 명사 a major overhaul 형태가 흔하다.

package.en: a set of plans offered together
package.ex: The Government announced an aid package.

paused.ex: The company paused its building plans.

people.ex: Many people came to the concert.

permission.ex: You need permission to build here.

permissions.en: official permits to build or do something
permissions.ex: The council granted two new permissions this month.

place.en: in place: working or being used
place.ex: New safety rules are now in place.

plan.ex: The council has a plan to plant trees.

planned.ex: The planned road will cost millions.

planning.en: deciding how to do things in the future

pleanála.en: Irish word for planning; part of a name

predictability.en: being able to know what will happen
predictability.ex: Businesses value predictability when they plan investment.

example.en: Investors value predictability in tax rules.
example.zh: 投資人重視稅務規則的可預測性。

note.meaning: 可預測性；能事先知道結果的程度。
note.usage: 常見 enhance/provide predictability、predictability for businesses。

noteEn.meaning: being able to know what will happen.

noteEs.exampleTr: Los inversores valoran la previsibilidad de las normas fiscales.
noteEs.meaning: posibilidad de saber de antemano; previsibilidad.
noteEs.usage: Se usa enhance predictability, greater predictability.

noteHi.exampleTr: निवेशक कर नियमों में पूर्वानुमेयता को महत्व देते हैं।
noteHi.meaning: पहले से अनुमान लगा पाने की क्षमता; पूर्वानुमेयता।
noteHi.usage: enhance predictability, greater predictability आम हैं।

noteJa.exampleTr: 投資家は税制の予測可能性を重視する。
noteJa.meaning: 結果を前もって予測できること；予測可能性。

noteKo.exampleTr: 투자자들은 세금 규칙의 예측 가능성을 중시한다.
noteKo.meaning: 미리 결과를 알 수 있는 정도; 예측 가능성.
noteKo.usage: enhance predictability, greater predictability 형태가 흔하다.

presented.ex: She presented her plan to the board.

procedure.en: a set way of doing something
procedure.ex: The safety procedure takes only five minutes.

proceed.ex: The meeting will proceed as planned.

proceedings.ex: She started legal proceedings against the firm.

process.en: a series of steps to do something
process.ex: The hiring process takes about a month.

projects.ex: Two new projects started this month.

proposals.ex: Under the proposals, fees will rise.

example.en: After protracted talks, the two sides agreed a deal.
example.zh: 經過冗長的談判，雙方達成了協議。

note.meaning: 拖延已久的；持續時間比預期長的。
note.usage: 常見 protracted delays/negotiations/dispute；帶負面意味。

noteEn.meaning: lasting longer than expected or wanted.

noteEs.exampleTr: Tras largas negociaciones, las dos partes acordaron un trato.
noteEs.meaning: que dura más de lo esperado; prolongado.
noteEs.usage: Se usa protracted delays/negotiations, con sentido negativo.

noteHi.exampleTr: लंबी बातचीत के बाद दोनों पक्ष समझौते पर पहुँचे।
noteHi.meaning: लंबा खिंचा हुआ; अपेक्षा से अधिक समय तक चलने वाला।
noteHi.usage: protracted delays/negotiations आम हैं; नकारात्मक अर्थ।

noteJa.exampleTr: 長引いた交渉の末、両者は合意した。
noteJa.usage: protracted delays/negotiations など否定的な意味で使う。

noteKo.usage: protracted delays/negotiations 등 부정적 의미로 쓴다.

raft.ex: The Government announced a raft of reforms.

rather.ex: Walk rather than drive if you can.

example.en: The company quickly rectified the billing error.
example.zh: 公司迅速更正了帳單錯誤。

note.usage: 常見 rectify a mistake/error/problem；比 correct/fix 正式。

noteEn.meaning: to correct something that is wrong.

noteEs.exampleTr: La empresa corrigió rápidamente el error de facturación.
noteEs.usage: Se usa rectify an error/mistake; más formal que fix.

noteHi.exampleTr: कंपनी ने बिल की गलती जल्दी सुधार दी।
noteHi.meaning: गलती या समस्या को ठीक करना; सुधारना।
noteHi.usage: rectify an error/mistake आम है; fix से अधिक औपचारिक।

noteJa.exampleTr: 会社は請求ミスをすぐに訂正した。
noteJa.meaning: 誤りや問題を正す；是正する。
noteJa.usage: rectify an error/mistake。fix より改まった語。

noteKo.usage: rectify an error/mistake. fix보다 격식 있는 말.

rectify.en: to correct something that is wrong
rectify.ex: The company promised to rectify the billing error.

example.en: The company quickly rectified the billing error.
example.zh: 公司迅速更正了帳單錯誤。

note.usage: 常見 rectify a mistake/error/problem；比 correct/fix 正式。

noteEn.meaning: to correct something that is wrong.

noteEs.exampleTr: La empresa corrigió rápidamente el error de facturación.
noteEs.usage: Se usa rectify an error/mistake; más formal que fix.

noteHi.exampleTr: कंपनी ने बिल की गलती जल्दी सुधार दी।
noteHi.meaning: गलती या समस्या को ठीक करना; सुधारना।
noteHi.usage: rectify an error/mistake आम है; fix से अधिक औपचारिक।

noteJa.exampleTr: 会社は請求ミスをすぐに訂正した。
noteJa.meaning: 誤りや問題を正す；是正する。
noteJa.usage: rectify an error/mistake。fix より改まった語。

noteKo.usage: rectify an error/mistake. fix보다 격식 있는 말.

reduce.ex: Drivers should reduce their speed in fog.

reforms.ex: The reforms could lower energy costs.

regulations.ex: New regulations will limit noise near schools.

removed.en: taken out of a job or position

represent.en: to act or compete for a group or country

required.en: made to do by a rule

residents.en: people who live in a place

review.en: to look at again to decide on changes

paragraphs: The Government wants to make planning faster. It wants more new homes. Ministers will discuss new rules at the Cabinet today. The changes start on Thursday.
An Coimisiún Pleanála is the national planning body. Under the new rules, it must make decisions within set times.
People can fix small mistakes in a planning application. They will not need to start again. Builders can also ask for more time to use a planning permission.
There are new rules for court cases about planning too. These changes could save about eight weeks. Some projects of up to 250 homes will not need a special environmental report.
sentZh: 政府想讓規劃審批更快。
它想要更多新住宅。
部長們今天將在內閣討論新規定。
這些改變將於週四開始。
An Coimisiún Pleanála是全國性的規劃機構。
根據新規定，它必須在規定的時間內做出決定。
民眾可以修正規劃申請中的小錯誤。
他們不需要重新開始。
建商也可以申請延長使用規劃許可的時間。
關於規劃的法院案件也有新規定。
這些改變可以節省大約八週。
一些多達250戶住宅的建案將不需要特別的環境報告。

paragraphs: The Government will discuss changes to the planning system at today's Cabinet meeting. Housing Minister James Browne and Planning Minister John Cummins will bring the plan, and the changes will start on Thursday.

The main change is that An Coimisiún Pleanála, the national planning body, will have to make decisions within fixed time limits set by law. Until now, there were no clear deadlines for many of its decisions.

There are also smaller changes. People will be able to correct small mistakes in a planning application without making a new application. It will also be possible to change a planning permission or make it last longer.

Court challenges to planning decisions, called judicial reviews, will change too. A new process could save about eight weeks. People will need to show a 'sufficient interest' to bring a case, and they will not be able to go on to the Court of Appeal.

In addition, new rules will allow some developments of up to 250 homes to go ahead without an Environmental Impact Assessment. The changes mean that the Planning and Development Act 2024 is now almost fully in place.
sentZh: 政府將在今天的內閣會議上討論規劃制度的改變。
住宅部長詹姆斯・布朗和規劃部長約翰・卡明斯將提出這項計畫，改變將於週四開始。
主要的改變是，全國規劃機構An Coimisiún Pleanála將必須在法律規定的固定時限內做出決定。
到目前為止，它的許多決定都沒有明確的期限。
也有一些較小的改變。
民眾將能修正規劃申請中的小錯誤，而不必提出新的申請。
也將可以修改規劃許可，或讓它的效期更長。
針對規劃決定的法院挑戰，也就是所謂的司法審查，也將改變。
新的流程可以節省大約八週。
民眾必須證明有「充分利益」才能提起訴訟，而且將不能再上訴到上訴法院。
此外，新規定將允許一些多達250戶住宅的開發案不需環境影響評估就能進行。
這些改變意味著《2024年規劃與發展法》現在幾乎已全面實施。

paragraphs: Ministers are set to approve a package of planning reforms at Cabinet today, including statutory deadlines for decisions by An Coimisiún Pleanála. The measures, brought forward by Minister for Housing James Browne and Minister of State for Planning John Cummins, are due to take effect on Thursday.
Under the changes, the national planning body will be required to meet consistent decision-making timelines laid down in law, a step intended to give applicants greater certainty.
Applicants will also be allowed to make minor corrections to an application without starting the process again, while existing permissions could be altered or have their duration extended.

Significant changes are planned for judicial reviews. A revised process for seeking leave could save around eight weeks, and anyone bringing a challenge will need to show 'sufficient interest'. Permissions under review will be paused so they do not run out, and the further appeal to the Court of Appeal will be removed.

Separately, regulations allowing developments of up to 250 homes to proceed without an Environmental Impact Assessment will also come into force on Thursday. Together, the reforms represent almost full implementation of the Planning and Development Act 2024.
sentZh: 部長們預計今天將在內閣通過一套規劃改革方案，其中包括為An Coimisiún Pleanála的決定訂定法定期限。
這些由住宅部長詹姆斯・布朗和規劃國務部長約翰・卡明斯提出的措施，預定於週四生效。
根據這些改變，全國規劃機構將必須遵守法律訂定的一致決策時程，此舉旨在讓申請人更有確定性。
申請人也將獲准對申請案做小幅修正，而不必重新開始整個流程，現有的許可也可以修改或延長效期。
司法審查方面也規劃了重大改變。
修訂後的申請許可流程可節省大約八週，而任何提出挑戰的人都必須證明具有「充分利益」。
接受審查的許可將暫停計時，以免過期，而向上訴法院進一步上訴的途徑將被取消。
另外，允許多達250戶住宅的開發案不需環境影響評估即可進行的法規，也將於週四生效。
整體而言，這些改革代表《2024年規劃與發展法》幾乎已全面實施。

paragraphs: The Cabinet is expected to sign off today on a raft of planning reforms that will, for the first time, impose statutory deadlines on An Coimisiún Pleanála. Spearheaded by Minister for Housing James Browne and Minister of State for Planning John Cummins, the measures are slated to take effect on Thursday.
Central to the package are uniform decision-making timelines enshrined in law, which ministers hope will curb the protracted delays that have long frustrated developers and residents alike.
The reforms also introduce a measure of flexibility: minor errors in applications may be rectified without resubmission, and permissions may be amended or have their lifespan extended.

Judicial reviews, frequently blamed for stalling major projects, are to be overhauled. A streamlined leave stage could shave roughly eight weeks off proceedings, challengers will have to demonstrate 'sufficient interest', permissions will be frozen while under challenge, and the onward appeal to the Court of Appeal will be scrapped.

In tandem, regulations exempting schemes of up to 250 homes from an Environmental Impact Assessment will come into force. Taken together, the changes mark the near-complete implementation of the Planning and Development Act 2024.
sentZh: 內閣預計今天將批准一系列規劃改革，首度為An Coimisiún Pleanála強制訂定法定期限。
這些措施由住宅部長詹姆斯・布朗和規劃國務部長約翰・卡明斯帶頭推動，預定於週四生效。
這套方案的核心是寫入法律的統一決策時程，部長們希望藉此遏止長久以來讓開發商和居民同樣感到挫折的冗長延誤。
改革也帶來一定的彈性：申請案中的小錯誤可以更正而無需重新提交，許可也可以修改或延長效期。
常被指責拖延大型建案的司法審查將全面改革。
精簡後的許可申請階段可讓訴訟程序縮短大約八週，挑戰者必須證明具有「充分利益」，受挑戰期間許可將被凍結，而再向上訴法院上訴的途徑將被廢除。
與此同時，豁免多達250戶住宅的建案進行環境影響評估的法規也將生效。
綜合來看，這些改變標誌著《2024年規劃與發展法》近乎全面實施。

paragraphs: The Cabinet is anticipated to approve a comprehensive set of planning reforms today, the most notable of which will establish statutory timelines for decisions by An Coimisiún Pleanála. The proposals, presented by the Minister for Housing, James Browne, and the Minister of State for Planning, John Cummins, are scheduled to come into effect on Thursday.
The introduction of consistent, legally binding timelines is intended to enhance predictability for applicants and, consequently, to accelerate the delivery of housing and infrastructure.
In addition, applicants will be permitted to rectify minor errors without submitting a new application, and existing permissions may be modified or extended in duration.

The reforms also substantially alter the judicial review process. A revised leave procedure could reduce proceedings by approximately eight weeks; applicants will be required to demonstrate 'sufficient interest'; and the option of a further appeal to the Court of Appeal will be eliminated. Nevertheless, permissions subject to review will be suspended rather than allowed to expire.

Furthermore, regulations enabling developments of up to 250 homes to proceed without an Environmental Impact Assessment will take effect simultaneously, thereby marking the virtual completion of the Planning and Development Act 2024.
sentZh: 內閣預計今天將批准一套全面的規劃改革，其中最值得注意的是為An Coimisiún Pleanála的決定訂定法定時程。
這些提案由住宅部長詹姆斯・布朗和規劃國務部長約翰・卡明斯提出，預定於週四生效。
引入一致且具法律約束力的時程，目的在於提高申請人的可預測性，並因此加快住宅與基礎設施的交付。
此外，申請人將獲准更正小錯誤而不必提交新的申請，現有的許可也可修改或延長效期。
改革也大幅改變了司法審查的程序。
修訂後的許可程序可將訴訟縮短大約八週；申請人必須證明具有「充分利益」；而進一步上訴到上訴法院的選項將被取消。
儘管如此，受審查的許可將被暫停計時，而不會任其過期。
此外，允許多達250戶住宅的開發案不需環境影響評估即可進行的法規將同時生效，從而標誌著《2024年規劃與發展法》幾乎已完成實施。
